post.title: $4B on Giving Tuesday 2025. Scammers noticed.
post.ig:
Americans gave $4.0 billion on Giving Tuesday 2025. Scammers noticed.

Giving Tuesday 2026 is Tuesday, December 1. US donations on the day grew from $1.97B in 2019 to $4.0B in 2025 (GivingTuesday Data Commons).
The copycat playbook: lookalike pages and posts, texts and emails with links, fake fundraisers, pay-by-app requests.
Example: a $50 gift on GoFundMe loses 2.9% + $0.30 = $1.75, so $48.25 reaches the organizer. On a fake page, $0 reaches the cause.
BBB Wise Giving Alliance standard: at least 65% of expenses on programs.

Sources: GivingTuesday Data Commons; FTC consumer alert, Nov. 2025; California, North Carolina and Arizona attorneys general; BBB; GoFundMe pricing.
News and education, not financial advice.
